title: Alarm Summary 01:00: GEN-1 Shutdown, Public Safety Building on UPS Power

fields.systemName: PSB BUILDING MANAGEMENT — POWER / GENERATOR ALARM SUMMARY
fields.site: Brennan County Public Safety Building, Ashford: 911 Center and EOC

alarms.source: EOC radio console: Corwin Fire Station 3
alarms.description: LOGGED TRAFFIC: Station 3 reports part of the bay roof is gone and the training room ceiling is leaking onto the tables. Station generator running. Cell service dead, radio only. Route from Ashford is one lane, with trees down past the Clarks River bridge.

alarms.source: Facilities maintenance tech, on site at GEN-1
alarms.description: TECH NOTE: Primary fuel filter is plugged with water, probably from the tank vent during the storm. One spare element on hand. Changing the filter and bleeding the lines will take about 45 min if nothing else goes wrong. If the tank has water in it, the new filter will plug again.
AHU-2 STOPPED: NO SUPPLY POWER. Equipment room cooling lost.
NORMAL LIGHTING POWER LOST. Emergency fixtures on internal battery.

alarms.source: UPS-B: EOC load (NWSChat, WebEOC, BrennanAlert on BCEMA-EOC-WO1, backup siren encoder)
alarms.description: UPS-B ON BATTERY. INPUT POWER LOST. Runtime below 30 min.

alarms.source: UPS-A: 911 load (POS-1, POS-2 with siren encoder, CAD, radio consoles)
alarms.description: UPS-A ON BATTERY. INPUT POWER LOST.
UTILITY NOT AVAILABLE · EMERGENCY SOURCE NOT AVAILABLE. Building load is on UPS-A and UPS-B only.
GEN-1 SHUTDOWN: FUEL FILTER DIFFERENTIAL HIGH / LOW FUEL PRESSURE. Locked out. Manual reset required.
LOW FUEL PRESSURE PRE-ALARM. Engine load dropping.
FUEL FILTER DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE HIGH.
WATER IN FUEL DETECTED: separator bowl.
TRANSFER TO EMERGENCY. GEN-1 on load.
UTILITY POWER LOST: all three phases.

fields.footer: PSB ON UPS ONLY · UPS-A about 38 min left (to about 01:41): 911 consoles and radio · UPS-B about 19 min left (to about 01:22): EOC · GEN-1 LOCKED OUT · 13 alarms since 00:00

instructorNote: Technical-hurdle inject: the EOC loses power first (UPS-B, about 01:22), then the 911 floor (UPS-A, about 01:41). The 911 Supervisor should get the Marshall County rollover ready before UPS-A runs out, and the EM Director should have Field check Station 3 before moving anyone there. The Warning Officer should move NWSChat and BrennanAlert to a laptop with its own power and connection and log the outage with the time. Watch whether anyone spots the water-in-fuel alarm at 00:47, which was acknowledged but never acted on, and asks about the fuel tank before trusting the one spare filter.
